title: RepoFusion-in-Decoder: Efficient Cross-File Code Completion via Lightweight Encoder Fusion
selection_reason: RepoFusion-in-Decoder extends a frozen decoder-only code LM with a lightweight encoder and cross-attention so cross-file code chunks are encoded and cached independently, substantially reducing prefill time for repository-level code completion.
venue: 2025 5th International Conference on Advanced Algorithms and Neural Networks (AANN)
